nom: Oars + Alps Everyday Anti-Aging Face Moisturizer with SPF 37

avis.titre: The Ideal Solution for Dry Skin and Sun Protection
avis.texte: As someone who struggles with dry skin and also sports a shaved head, finding the right moisturizer has been a bit of a journey. My requirements are fairly straightforward—I need a product that moisturizes effectively and offers sun protection. The Oars + Alps SPF 37 Sunscreen and Everyday Anti-Aging Face Moisturizer ticks both of these boxes perfectly. This moisturizer stands out because of its ideal consistency. It's neither too thick nor too runny, which is a significant advantage. I've tried products in the past that were difficult to absorb, leaving a greasy feel, or too fluid, causing them to run into my eyes and sting. Thankfully, this Oars + Alps moisturizer absorbs beautifully without any residue and stays in place, which means no more burning eyes. For those with a bald head like mine, this product is a game-changer. It keeps the entire head moisturized and protected from the sun's harmful rays. While I can't definitively say the anti-aging properties have made me look ten years younger, I certainly feel more confident. Much of this newfound confidence comes from not having to deal with dry, flaky skin anymore. In conclusion, if you're looking for a reliable face moisturizer that provides sun protection and maintains optimal skin moisture—especially if you're bald—then I highly recommend the Oars + Alps SPF 37 Sunscreen and Everyday Anti-Aging Face Moisturizer. avis.titre: The best facial moisturizer with sunscreen!
avis.texte: I have never written a review for a facial sunscreen before because I never found any that I liked. Either they made my face too greasy or left a white cast on my skin. This product is actually fantastic! It doesn’t turn my face into an oil slick, but provides the perfect amount of moisture and gives my skin a healthy, hydrated glow. No white cast either! I have sensitive skin and there is nothing in this product that bothers my skin at all. A little goes a long way and this product works better than day creams I’ve used at a much higher price point. Great product at a great price…please don’t change a thing, Oars & Alps!

avis.titre: Took me 20yrs to find the perfect product
avis.texte: I absolutely Love this product! I have sensitive skin easy to break out. My face is a combination of oily & dry in some areas. This is the first product I have ever tried that has not broke me out. It doesn’t leave a greasy feel. And I love the fact I don’t get sun burned everyday nor does it irritate my skin! I have tried so many name brand products in different prices high and low. This is the first to ever have did my face oh so good and I’m so glad I found this product! I absolutely rave about this product as it took me 20yrs to find something tolerable but not even tolerable, it actually works! I will pass this along and let everyone in on this secret perfect product!! ♥️

avis.titre: Lightweight, non‑greasy SPF that actually feels like skincareLightweight, non‑greasy SPF that actually feels like skinca
avis.texte: This moisturizer surprised me in the best way. It goes on like a lightweight gel‑cream, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave that heavy, greasy sunscreen film. The hyaluronic acid gives a nice boost of hydration without making my skin shiny, and the SPF 37 is perfect for daily protection. It works well under makeup and doesn’t pill, which is a big win. No white cast, no strong scent, and no breakouts. If you want a simple, effective moisturizer with real SPF that feels good on your skin, this is a great everyday option.

avis.titre: very protective, but sometimes has a white cast
avis.texte: very nice product and makes my skin extremely soft and feel protected. However, when using it on damp or wet skim, it tends to leave a white cast and needs more time to incorporate to get rid of. Overall, though, very strong and useful product

The sunscreen does the job and provides decent protection, but I’m not overly impressed. The texture feels a little greasy going on, and it leaves more shine than I’d like. It’s also harder to rub in compared to other brands I’ve used. I do appreciate that it’s reef-safe and has a clean ingredient list, but for the price I expected a smoother application

avis.titre: It puts the sunscreen on its skin
avis.texte: I am a sunscreen snob. I do not like feeling like I am wearing sunscreen but I am also blessed with skin that could burn at night and live closer to the sun than the average person. So, I wear sunscreen daily. I like this one, it does not feel like I am coating myself in a rubbery film. I do not avoid the sun to avoid putting on sunscreen with this, yay!

Love this sunscreen moisturizer. Provides sun protection without the heaviness or oiliness. It also does not have that standard sunscreen smell, which is a plus for me. For a moisturizer it provides the moisture my aging skin needs. Good quality and value for the money. I will purchase again.

Big fan of the O&A product line and was excited to see some new Spring products from them! This face moisturizer has it all. No scent, easy to apply, and doesn’t leave hands wet/oily afterwards. Feels like a premium product.

avis.titre: Not for Everyday, Slight Oily feel
avis.texte: I bought this for everyday use because it's advertised to be lightweight. This sunscreen was not lightweight at all for me. I have asian skin, sometimes it can lean more towards oily. I used to use La Roche Posay AM face lotion. That felt more lightweight than this, so I'll just go back to that. Another dislike is that the cap hole is way too wide in my opinion. The lotion tends to pour out. I wish it wasn't so wide bc it leaves a mess. For comparison I provided a picture of the Oars+Alps lotion cap (yellow) beside a Sun Bum face lotion cap (brown). I plan to just use this lotion for outdoor activities such as weekend fishing, biking etc. but not for everyday use.

avis.titre: Did not blend into skin at all
avis.texte: Just tried this for the first time today and was very disappointed. I've been using Fenty's Hydrolyzer for a while now but wanted to look for a cheaper alternative. This was highly rated, so I bought it. Tried it out today and it was very much sunscreen consistency, very white. I put it on my face and I really had to rub it in to get it to not be white on my face. After about a minute, it was sort of pilling on my face (see pic 1) and then I swiped my finger along my cheek and pic 2 is what came off. Absolutely did not sink into my (dry!!) skin and just sat on top. Definitely returning this.

I was looking for the best face SPF and this one came up in my search multiple times. So I bought and tried it out and was highly disappointed. Unfortunately I didn’t like that the first time I put it on it came off like glue while applying it. This is the main reason I was looking for a face SPF because most of them do that on my face. Needless to say I definitely returned it. Not for me.

I did not use this for very long-2 days-and I ended up getting a rash and skin broke out. It became red and bumpy. The actual product seemed kind of empty when I first opened it so maybe this one was defective? I’m not sure. It went on really smooth and was not heavy at all. A lot would come out at a time so I had to learn to put it back inside. Overall I wouldn’t recommend and I wouldn’t buy again! (My skin a little dry/oily)

I didn’t realize when I purchased because it looks like a natural product but it has Octocrylene in it, which if you search this ingredient and it’s effects, it’s not positive. For that reason, I cannot recommend this product and won’t use it. I stick to mineral based sunscreens that don’t have this ingredient and that’s what I thought I was buying with this product.
